sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the July 31 update to the Flash model, delivering the best performance for its size and outperforming V4-Pro (Preview). Designed for coding, agentic and chat workflows with a 1M context window, in this guide we'll show you how to run DeepSeek-V4-Flash - 0731 locally using Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs.
